ROOT_CAUSE: In `_cstack`, when `right` is a CompoundModel (like `cm = Linear1D(10) & Linear1D(5)`), the code incorrectly treats it as an ndarray by using `.shape[1]` and slicing with `-right.shape[0]:`. This fails because CompoundModels are not ndarrays, leading to incorrect coordinate matrix construction for nested models.
OLD: `cright = np.zeros((noutp, right.shape[1]))
cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1`
NEW: `if isinstance(right, Model):
    cright = _coord_matrix(right, 'right', noutp)
else:
    cright = np.zeros((noutp, right.shape[1]))
cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1`
